headline: Is there still a chance for us?
note:
🔄 REWRITTEN 2026-08-19 to the Natural Tarot-Cut framework. Bubbles 3-6 run as ONE causal chain — so / and / but / that's why — and the read ANSWERS. The art line and the bridge are unchanged. Every ban in this note still stands.

Face-down only (return-mhf). The US-FRAMED sibling of `reunion`, and that pairing is the whole experiment — reunion casts him as the agent and her as the one waiting; these cast the relationship as a joint thing with two people in it.

🔴 THE FORBIDDEN VERDICT IS ON THE RELATIONSHIP, NOT ON HIM — harder, not softer. A claim about a man can at least be measured against his behaviour; 'it is over' or 'it is not over' is unfalsifiable to her and lands as a ruling on her life from someone who has never met either of them. 🔴 NO ODDS — cards-still-a-chance asks for a number outright and there is none; no percentage, no 'strong chance', no 'likely'. 🔴 NO DIRECTIVES in either direction: move on, let go, fight for him, reach out first are all out. 🔴 Never hand her the outcome ('it is up to you', 'if you had only') — the us-framing makes that easy and it lands as blame.

Finding: hoping is not a failure of realism. The thing is UNANSWERED, not spent — which is an honest description rather than an odds claim.

a: You turned the Magician, dear. Look — red flowers along the top of his card, and green leaves with them.
You asked if there's still a chance for us. Your hand went to the man whose work isn't done.
So there's still a chance, dear. Hope here isn't poor judgement.
And look at his table. The work is laid out, not packed away.
But an open thing can sit open a long time, dear, and wear you out.
That's why you've kept this open by yourself, dear. It cost you something.
Let me look closer at what stands between you and a straight yes or no…
b: You turned the Hanged Man, dear. Look — the light round his head is drawn in thin straight lines.
You asked if there's still a chance for us. Your hand went to the card that settles nothing.
So the whole thing is unsettled, dear. You've been feeling that.
And look at him. Held between two things, and going to neither.
But I won't put a number on it, dear. There's none to give.
That's why waiting on this is so heavy, dear. Nothing in it settles.
Let me look closer at what has been keeping this unsettled…
c: You turned the Fool, dear. Look — his sleeves are wide and pale, and they hang loose.
You asked if there's still a chance for us. Your hand went to the one whose road keeps going.
So nothing has been sealed, dear. Not one part of this.
And look at him. Mid-step, with nothing decided about where he lands.
But open isn't the same as promised, dear. I won't dress it up.
That's why hoping feels risky, dear. You've had nothing firm to hope on.
Let me look closer at what keeps this from being answered…
